versions.label: Steam Linux (build 9573671)
versions.testedOn: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra (SM-F976B), Adreno 840, Android 17
versions.notes: Native 32-bit Linux port, launched through Steam with FEX 2610 and Ubuntu 24.04. Keep FEX_TSOENABLED=1 even with the Performance preset: disabling TSO caused a black screen / SIGSEGV. Requires the 32-bit OpenGL thunk, Zink and the NVIDIA GL vendor override. -nolauncher bypasses Feral's options dialog; if it still appears, set GameOptionsDialogShouldShow=0 in the game's preferences. Startup and an in-game scene were checked on build 9573671; long-session stability and other builds are untested. The game must be stored inside the container, not on shared storage (FEX needs executable mappings).
